$comment: Hand-authored. Read by build_mask.py, which raises (never lowers) the mask depth along each centreline. seamarkIndex is the feature's position in app/public/data/seamarks.json when authored; lat/lon identify the mark if that file is regenerated. A point is the midpoint of its marks; the two single-mark points have no charted partner in seamarks.json and use the mark position.

channels.depthBasis: Channel-edge figure (ca. 4.0 m), deliberately below the charted 4.4 m / 4.5 m centre depths.

source.title: Marstal Havn
source.quote: …fra S gennem Marstal Søndre Løb (4,4 m)… dybden 4,5 m kun til stede i en bredde på 20 m i rendens midte. Uden for dette område aftager dybden til ca. 4,0 m ved rendens kanter.

caveats: The channel silts up; it was re-dredged in February 2026 (Ærø Kommune notice: https://aeroehavne.com/dansk/nyheder-om-havnene/oprensning-af-sand-fra-soendre-loeb-i-marts).
Wind-driven water level varies by about ±1.2 m.
The source does not state a datum; mean water level is assumed.
The channel is narrower than one ~46 m mask cell, so the 4.0 m applies to the cell run along the buoy line, not to the cell's whole area.
